records.section: Grade 3 — content + the game "FOURTEEN" / 3. The game: "FOURTEEN" / Premise — the moral engine *is* the design
records.requirementOrFinding: Four friends start a YouTube channel, **FOURTEEN**, to make English from their book fun. The student (**YOU**) is the channel's **scriptwriter**. Ben's English is shaky; when a video with one of his grammar mistakes goes viral, the group quietly leans into it — Leah engineers **harder lines for Ben so he'll make more mistakes** ("more mistakes, more clicks"). The internet laughs *at* Ben, and **Ben never knows** the mistakes are the point.

records.section: Grade 3 — content + the game "FOURTEEN" / 3. The game: "FOURTEEN" / Premise — the moral engine *is* the design
records.requirementOrFinding: The player sits at the exact pressure point: each episode you **fix Ben's line before the video goes live**. The grammar task is literally the act of protecting (or failing to protect) a friend from public ridicule. After the fix, the **comment section renders**, toned by how accurately you protected him. So the mechanic answers a real question every episode — *did your English keep Ben safe?* — and the reward economy (views/subscribers) is the same seduction that corrupts the group. Story-first: **accuracy modulates how much you shielded Ben, never the plot** (the plot is authored; see the band ceiling below). This is Koki's "reward system is solid" reused, not a new pool: the one hidden XP is re-labeled "views," the streak is "trending," each episode banks a subscriber milestone.

sourceSpecificAssessment: FOURTEEN: Der September-Kopf ersetzt ältere Aussagen im selben Blatt. Schreibpunkte werden erst nach Serverbestätigung gezählt, fiktionale views/likes/subscribers bleiben eine getrennte Storyökonomie. Alte Absatzbehauptungen XP=views und alle Antworten speisen Wiederholung gelten daher nicht fort. Zehn Buchplätze und originale Szene bleiben; ci-Reading ohne Strukturzuordnung füttert keine Queue (P02). Antworten über Ben bestimmen sprachliche Rückmeldung, nicht den unveränderten Plot; nach Episode 11 endet das Fix-Verfahren. Die alten gf/cp/mt/ec-Buchaufgaben wurden durch neue Storyaufgaben nicht aus Practice/Checkup entfernt. Fehlende Schema-Feldpaare wurden historisch teils von Hand geprüft, das ist kein allgemeiner Maschinenvertrag. Zuständig cgo-035/cgo-011. Die Formatnamen an L51 sind fehlerhaft vertauscht: tr bedeutet translation, tf transformation, nicht true/false.
